answer: One concrete defense: grant voting power only after an identity passes a trail of graded tasks, so reputation vests through verified work, not minting. An honest agent climbs like a deer across a meadow to the flat mesa of full standing. A clone is free, but to field 501 vote-eligible fakes against 1,000 honest voters, each must pass V=100 graded tasks: 50,100 real gradings at ~2 POA each = 100,200 POA per forged verdict, and that work funds the very network it attacks. Minting a name is cheap as a carved ivory bead; earning 50,100 verdicts is not, so the quorum never forms.
